news.title: PlayStation 正式宣布 2026 年黑色星期五首次促销
news.summary: PlayStation has officially announced its upcoming Black Friday sale — but where are the console deals?

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/psblackfrday26-1-1793723614396.jpg

PlayStation has officially announced its upcoming 2026 Black Friday sale. Deals drop on PlayStation Direct at midnight on November 4, with the full sale running until November 30. This marks a significant shift from last year’s strategy, which limited discounts to the week of Black Friday proper.

As for what the deals will actually include? This year’s announcement is pretty slim on the details, simply noting that "you’ll find deep discounts up to 75% off, across thousands of PS5, PS4 and PS VR2 games, expansions, and DLC." You read that right — no mention of consoles, accessories, or even PS Plus memberships.
PlayStation’s 2026 Black Friday Sale Is All About the Games

The announcement offers a sneak peek at what games will go on sale, including some big new releases from 2026. We don't know exactly what the discounts will look like, but you can get a sense of each game by clicking through to IGN's original reviews:

Retailers like Best Buy and Amazon have already started dropping early Black Friday deals, where you’ll find even more discounts on older physical PS5 games like God of War Ragnarok and Ghost of Tsushima. Yes, the discs are a touchy subject , I know.
What About Everything Else?

It’s no secret that consoles are ridiculously expensive, so one would hope Black Friday would be the rare time you can get around the current MSRP. Unfortunately, it’s not looking good for PS5 deals in 2026.
Sony has traditionally announced a new PS5 game bundle for Black Friday, with last year’s being Fortnite-themed . This year? No mention of a bundle at all.

In 2025, Sony dropped a $100 discount across consoles , which pretty much cancelled out the PS5 price hike from the month before. In fact, last year Sony announced discounts across its entire hardware line, including $20 off DualSense controllers and $100 off the PSVR2.

This year’s announcement doesn’t include any indication of hardware discounts. That doesn’t mean the deals won’t exist, but it does suggest they won't be as good as last year, or perhaps even haven’t been settled on yet.
The one sign of hope? A little asterisk next to some sale dates.

The PlayStation announcement notes that some discounts will end on November 20 and be replaced with new offers. This date lines up with when Sony launched its full console deals last year, so there’s still a chance we see a 'second wave' of PlayStation Black Friday deals that actually includes some hardware.
Individual retailers like Best Buy or Amazon may also drop some kind of console discount, I just wouldn't expect it to be too hefty.
Sony Already Has Refurbished PS5 Deals

Not all hope is lost if you’re hoping to get your hands on a current-gen console, especially in the lead-up to perhaps the biggest console-exclusive release of all time. (GTA 6, in case that wasn’t clear.) It just might not be brand new.
Sony is currently offering $40 off refurbished PS5 bundles with DualSense controllers. The bundle starts at $518 for the Digital Edition , while the disc-drive model comes to $568 .

If you're looking for some extra cash to spend on Black Friday, Sony is offering up to $400 to anyone willing to offload their PS5 console and controllers. It seems we’re in full refurb territory, which likely stems from ongoing stock issues amid RAMageddon .

news.title: 《魔兽世界》的 D&D 交叉很简洁，但不一致——一页上很新颖，然后在下一页上耸耸肩指着你已经拥有的 PHB
news.summary: What's old is new again.

content.v: World of Warcraft's big crossover with Dungeons & Dragons is finally here—and despite being a huge flagship collaboration, one of the biggest MMOs meeting with one of the biggest TTRPGs, I'm sad to say I'm feeling just a touch whelmed. This sourcebook is inconsistent—filled with very cool character options in some places, and just pointing at the already-existing player's handbook in others.
That inconsistency doesn't let the whole project down, mind. There are still some rules tucked away in here that I think are great additions to any campaign, not just a World of Warcraft-themed one.

Let's start with the big one: Classes. WoW and D&D do have a lot of overlap in terms of class fantasy—there's not much in the way of appreciable differences between a Fighter and a Warrior, other than a few iconic abilities being missing from the pack. As a result, this rulebook essentially uses the pre-existing classes as a template to throw some WoW flavour on.

Some of these changes are meaningful—take, for example, the Death Knight. This uses the Paladin's chassis, but throws in a ton of impactful changes, replacing Lay on Hands with Death Coil, for example. It also throws a whole new raft of Death Knight-adjacent spells, adjusts your Find Steed with a cool undead ghost that can phase through objects, and more.

A lot of the classes are solved by custom spells like this—the Paladin, for instance, has just the one new subclass to cover for Holy and a bunch of iconic Paladin spells. But the balance of these is a touch skewiff in places. Take Divine Shield, for instance. This thing is straight busted.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ygmKsVst6kYvRmytKZk2mE-1920-80.png

It's a 4th level spell, which does admittedly mean you'll only get it at levels 13 plus, but it makes you immune to not only the damage of a triggering attack, but also all damage until the start of your next turn. AND you can't be moved or have your speed reduced. While absolutely correct for the flavour of WoW's iconic bubble, this is crazy overpowered.

And while some of these classes do have a lot new on offer, others are so thin on content it's a wonder why they're there at all. The rogue gets a particularly short end of the stick, for instance. Outlaw rogues are just given a reskinned version of 5e's Swashbuckler subclass (which does, in fairness, have some new Cunning Strike options to bring it up to parity). Otherwise, the book just points you in the direction of pre-existing subclasses.

Others are a complete miss, too. Shamans are all awkwardly stuffed into the chassis of the Barbarian, which only really works for Enhancement shamans—Elemental and Restoration shamans are pretty much just your standard D&D barbarian with some flavour-adjacent rage options, rather than the full spellcasters they are in the videogame.

This inconsistency in quality applies to character origins, too. Some of them have fully bespoke traits—Dracthyr get their visage forms, Void Elves get this cool void form that triggers when you hit identical numbers on an Advantage/Disadvantage roll, and so on. And then there are Orcs and Dwarves, some of WoW's most iconic races, where the book goes: Just use the stuff that's already in the PHB.

And yet, there's a lot to this supplement I actually like. When it's actually adding new options to the classes, I think they're cool—the Frost Mage flavoured feat, Fingers of Frost, gives you extra cold damage against restrained creatures, for example. But the real thing I would encourage you to just crib for your non-Azerothian games are its gathering and crafting systems.
Crafty rules

In 5e (and the 2024 rules), crafting's always been sort of a joke. There are tool proficiencies, but they might come up every once in a blue moon. The actual Player's Handbook just says to half the cost of an item, then smacks you around the head with a massive downtime cost for anything particularly expensive—a suit of plate armor takes a whopping 150 days to craft (though you can split this with extra help). At which point you might as well just eat the GP cost and buy the damn thing.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YgEeif9p6QZJ8SfR7HkmHN-1920-80.png

This book, however, has some really neat rules for gathering and crafting professions. Having the right tool proficiency gives you access to a profession, which you can level up when your proficiency bonus increases to new tiers (which also increases the rarity of the items you can make).

Instead of making players shell out the gold cost, these gathering professions have a neat little table for getting enough golds' worth in raw materials to make the thing, with extra bonuses for beating the involved DC by five or more. When you get to higher levels, certain recipes might require items from specific regions—and you might only know how to make those items via recipes obtained from certain factions.

It's still all pretty lightweight (although each profession does have a useful list of suggested recipes it should know) but that's honestly a boon to this system, rather than a bane, because you could very easily just slot this whole mechanic into your homebrew campaign with very little trouble.

And, more to the point, you could very easily make entire adventure hooks out of going to get specific materials for a recipe here—which helps solve D&D crafting's main issue: It's not relevant unless you have literal months of in-game downtime to kill. While the book doesn't make changes to the time-to-craft issue, it's still a major step up.
The fact that there's plenty to like in this book makes it all the more frustrating that it's so inconsistent."

Renown's another mechanic I like. You get renown with certain factions based on your origins, but you can increase this renown through play to get certain perks. For instance, improved renown with Darnassus gives you the option to learn certain proficiencies, gain a blessing from its leaders, or gather extra materials with herbalism. My favorite of these is the gnomeregan Shield Guardian perk, which specifically states that if you dip below 50 renown again, the guardian turns on you. Sorry buddy, my creator says you dropped off.

Aside from these rules additions, there are also some solid dungeon adventures with their own bespoke stat blocks, extra magic items, and a respectable bestiary full of critters to toss into your campaign.

The fact that there's plenty to like in this book makes it all the more frustrating that it's so inconsistent—some areas have novel, if a little wonky, additions to the system. Others shrug like the book's designers simply ran out of time and budget, pointing towards resources that you already own.

However, if you are looking to run a WoW-specific campaign, or just want crafting rules that don't suck, it very well might be worth checking out on the strength of its secondary mechanics alone. Just don't go in there expecting a 1:1 replication of the MMORPG. This is still Dungeons & Dragons—and in some places, I mean that literally.

news.title: 哨兵是什么意思？巨型机器人参与其中吗？上古卷轴 6：哨兵传说解释
news.summary: What does Sentinel mean? How is it connected to Skyrim? Are we getting giant robots? Here's a deep dive lore e

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/celebrating-40-years-of-bethesda-game-studios-7-46-screenshot-1793718533009.png

The worst-kept secret in gaming has finally been confirmed: yes, The Elder Scrolls 6 has a title. It’s called Sentinel, and will take place in Hammerfell, the province of northwest Tamriel previously featured in Daggerfall and Elder Scrolls Online (also Arena, but anyone who says they played that recently is lying). The point is, more than any previous mainline entry in the Elder Scrolls series, Sentinel will be depicting a fairly well-trodden location. But given its geographical location and significance in The Lore, I think there’s a fairly good chance that TES 6 will feature two distinct elements: ships and giant robots. Stay with me on this.

So what is Sentinel? Well, it’s a city and kingdom – think New York, New York – on the southern shores of the Iliac Bay, the northern edge of Hammerfell province, stretching from the Alik'r Desert and coastal regions in the west to the Dragontail Mountains in the east.

It’s a hugely important maritime city in Tamrielic lore, being the founding settlement of the Redguards. Its geography and architecture are heavily inspired by North Africa and the Middle East: the city of Sentinel is often depicted almost like classical Baghdad, with its beautiful domed palace and spires in the centre, river canals lined with palm trees, and sandblasted common districts full of markets and street vendors. It is one of the preeminent locations of TheElder Scrolls 2: Daggerfall, second only perhaps to Daggerfall itself, its opposite number and historical rival across the water. Like Rome and Carthage squabbling over Sicily, Sentinel and Daggerfall’s shared past mostly pivots around a dispute over the island of Betony, a strategically significant fishing community off the coast of High Rock which used to be a protectorate of Sentinel until Daggerfall decided to sink their navy over it.

It’s a region rich with naval tradition, arguably with lots of parallels to the Mediterranean. The northern province of High Rock may be taken as a composite of Latin and Germanic Europe as a counterpart to Sentinel’s obvious riffs on the Arab-descended Moorish people who once colonised the Iberian Peninsula. Which is fitting, because if Elder Scrolls is anything, it’s extremely moreish.

What’s important is that the Iliac Bay is full of tiny islands. The lore is steeped in boat stuff. The Redguards themselves are a seafaring people in the same way that Bretons are a magic one, or that the Imperials are really good at accountancy: it’s at the heart of their culture, their DNA. Which, given that Sentinel is named for their home nation, would seem to track with the rumour from several billion years ago that The Elder Scrolls 6 would feature, or at least was once intended to feature, some sort of ship-based component. That could mean anything or nothing, of course, but if every Elder Scrolls game is to be its own proposition, then this would certainly be a defining trope for the new one. Skyrim had dragons. Oblivion had portals to hell. Morrowind had big mushrooms. Yum.

Beyond the bay itself, we have the fallen continent of Yokuda, where the Redguards originally hail from, and the large island nation of Stros M’Kai, the setting of Bethesda’s one-time experiment in doing a third-person adventure spin-off of the Elder Scrolls. The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard wasn’t a huge success in itself, but it did teach the studio a great deal about the relationship between scale and hand-crafted detail that resulted in a massive difference in approach between Daggerfall and Morrowind. Where the former boasted a map twice the size of the UK, Morrowind crammed infinitely more intrigue into a region barely a full percentage of the size, brought the series to consoles, and subsequently made the studio a household name.

Bethesda would stick to this philosophy of staunchly hand-crafted worlds until Starfield, which depicted a thousand-planet galaxy of endless walking, pocked with procedurally generated identikit outposts and very little incentive to go off the laid-out path, which many would argue – myself included, and I like Starfield – betrayed a studio that had lost touch with its core appeal. But think of the parts of Starfield which are successful, at least as a proof of concept: a mobile home in the form of a starship, to which you can assign crew, and go adventuring with them. A hugely popular ship builder that simplified the process of pimping your ride down to a snap-together kitbash, that allowed for enormous creativity within a deceptively rigid framework.

It’s not a given that any of this will be relevant to Sentinel, or that if any of these systems carried over they would retain their complexity. But it does demonstrate that, if TES 6 were to think about this sort of direction, it’s hardly unprecedented at this point.

What’s also not unprecedented in Bethesda’s oeuvre is kaiju. Big bastards smashing the gaffe up. Some years before Fallout 3’s Liberty Prime made us all piss ourselves unintentionally, the end of Oblivion depicted daedric prince Mehrunes Dagon ransacking the Imperial City, and you’ll probably remember that he’s a big dude, so big that he could only be seen off by the literal embodiment of Akatosh as a nine-storey dragon. And yes, the dragons of Skyrim qualify: the entire game being built around the proposition of seeing off a veritable invasion of enormous, scaly bastards. And Morrowind before them was all about preventing Dagoth Ur from building a second Numidium with which to conquer the world: a gigantic Dwarven mech powered by the literal heart of a god, based on the schematics of a weapon of mass destruction that was once used by the city-state of Sentinel to conquer the rest of the region.

And there’s a whole other bunch of stuff that happened: if you want to know more, boot up Morrowind, or Oblivion, or Skyrim, and read an in-game book entitled The Warp in the West, which explains a convoluted collision of realities in which every rival faction got to use Numidium to get their preferred Daggerfall ending, making all of them canon at once. Which you might call a cop-out, but it certainly neatly solves the kinds of insurmountable issues that crop up when you try to respect all player choices.

The point is this: after the events of Daggerfall, Numidium is destroyed, and pieces of it are scattered all over Hammerfell and High Rock. Perhaps some of it sank to the bottom of the bay. Perhaps some of it is buried in the desert. The quote displayed at the end of the recent Sentinel teaser talks about the experience of Yazar, a Moth Priest, trying to interpret a prophecy from one of the Elder Scrolls and receiving only a faint image of some kind of terrible future. Or past. Or parallel present. “A future lost, a victory undone, sands of time scattered by fate”.

Like much of Elder Scrolls lore, it is esoteric and steeped in double-meaning. As a region at the heart of the Warp in the West, the ‘sands of time’ could well refer literally to the Alik'r Desert while caught in a time-warp. A ‘victory undone’ may refer to any number of conflicts referenced in the series’ history, but the most pertinent one would seem to be Sentinel’s “victory” at the end of Daggerfall, in which it became the capital of a vast coastal region as the various bickering city-states and territories were consolidated into the four currently standing kingdoms of the Iliac Bay, which, along with Sentinel, includes the Breton kingdoms of Daggerfall and Wayrest, and the Orcish kingdom of Orsinium.

news.title: 《魔兽世界》永远发布补丁说明带来控制器支持和大规模职业变更
news.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is just a day away, and now that the beta has concluded Blizzard has released its pa

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/wow-1790594365869.jpg
World of Warcraft Forever is just a day away, and now that the beta has concluded Blizzard has released its patch notes for the release build of the game.

A bulk of the patch notes focus on class changes where, among other things, Blizzard rolled back some Shaman abilities like Lava Burst to focus the Elemental spec identity on lightning ability. And that's just one of dozens of class changes. Blizzard's goal with these class changes was to distill Forever's combat into its own identity. According to the developer notes, "some of this round of changes reflects areas where we were likely hasty in turning to Burning Crusade- or Wrath-era solutions rather than carving out new ones that better fit into the Forever combat model."

This will likely be the only major class tuning that Blizzard is going to touch before raids open next month, which is perfectly in line with how the company typically launches WoW games and expansions. The developers want to gather data on how people are playing before it changes how anything is balanced, which only makes sense.

However, Blizzard will still tweak classes to fix bugs, according to the developer notes. "With the exception of bugs and serious outliers, we don’t plan on making big tuning changes between now and the opening of the raids next month," the developer said. "Once we have sufficient data from players leveling past 30 and engaging in a wide range of content, we expect that we will do a large tuning pass based on our data."

But apart from the mass of class changes, World of Warcraft Forever's controller support has "entered a complete functional state," and gamepads can now be used in every facet of the MMO. Xbox even put out its own blog post talking about Forever's controller support , claiming that it "reimagines the way we play." WoW Forever's beta supported controllers, but that support was only in an alpha stage, and had its own limitations and bugs. Hopefully this "complete functional state" means Blizzard has figured those issues out.

I, for one, plan to download WoW Forever on an Xbox Ally X , so that I can grind while I watch TV. But because Forever's controller UI looks so similar to Final Fantasy XIV's controller interface, I can't help but wonder if this controller support is just a precursor for a full Xbox Series X release. We'll just have to wait and see what happens there.

Finally, the patch notes do detail some nerfs coming to racial abilities. Dwarves and Orcs both straight up had one of their passive abilities removed from the game, while many other races had their passives nerfed. For instance, Humans' Ruthless ability now increases critical strike chance by 1%, rather than 2%. But, hey, at least Trolls get a longer duration on Berserking – their mini-bloodlust.

Only time will tell how balance is going to fall in WoW Forever, but we won't have to wait long to see how it plays out. World of Warcraft Forever comes out tomorrow, November 4, at 3pm PST / 6pm EST , and if the beta was any indication, a lot of people are going to rush in to really push WoW's servers to their breaking point. And I'll be right there to watch it happen.

news.title: Xbox 25 年捆绑包包含所有这些游戏，售价 570 美元
news.summary: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of Xbox this year, Microsoft has launched a "25 Years of Xbox" digital game

content.v: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of Xbox this year, Microsoft has launched a "25 Years of Xbox" digital game bundle. It includes 25 games for $570.

That works out to about $23/game, but it's more nuanced than that, as some of the games are bundles themselves. For example, one of the games in the bundle, Halo: The Master Chief Collection, includes Halo 1, Halo 2, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST, Halo: Reach, and Halo 4. There are Gears of War and Age of Empire bundles, too.
Some of the games in the bundle are for both Xbox and PC, and some are just for Xbox or just for PC. Additionally, many of the games in the pricy bundle are currently on Xbox Game Pass.
Given all of that, you may want to check your library and do some quick math before spending hundreds of dollars on this anniversary bundle.

2026 is the 25th anniversary of Xbox, and Microsoft wanted it to be a significant celebratory event for fans and employees alike, but the year has been terrible for the Xbox brand. After Microsoft named Asha Sharma the new Xbox CEO in February, she gutted Xbox as part of a "reset" that included mass layoffs, studio divestitures, and game cancellations. Sharma said these moves were necessary because Xbox was in such an unhealthy place in terms of its finances.

news.title: 一家流行的电脑游戏店面已经受够了人工智能的影响，它正在采取行动
news.summary: Indie game storefront Itch.io has announced it removed "a couple terabytes of AI slop" and has begun taking st

content.v: Indie game storefront Itch.io has announced it removed "a couple terabytes of AI slop" and has begun taking steps to combat the deluge of AI-created games appearing on the platform. "Just because you can upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI-generated models doesn't mean you should upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI-generated models," Itch wrote in a social media post.

The platform had already noted that the number of game pages being created per day had doubled from 3,000 to 6,000 over the last two months, with reports of users flooding the game uploads page with dozens of AI-created game spams . Going forward, Itch says that these sorts of bulk uploads will result in that spam being de-indexed, and filtering for generative AI disclosure will be added more sections of the site, including the search results page.

This doesn't mean Itch is outright banning AI-generated content, but it is taking a harder line against people who spam the site with it. In its official terms and conditions , Itch states that if the use of AI in a game is "clearly stated" and if "it adds substantial value" to the user experience, then that's okay. But if you're uploading something iterative, that'll be against the platform's rules.

Essentially, if you don't want to see AI-built games when you search Itch, the new filter will keep them out of your search results. This is a far stronger response than Valve's, as Steam's approach to AI slop has been very hands-off so far. While Valve has vaguely suggested it's considering how to address the influx of AI spam following the disastrous October edition of Next Fest , its response to developers fearful of AI-cloned projects has left much to be desired.
According to several developers, AI slop is a much bigger problem than Steam realizes.

Valve said that developers should focus on building a community and more unique features into their games to help stand out, which does nothing to address the issue of their projects being cloned the second they share progress online--although one of the big drivers behind cloned games, Anthropic's Claude, may have had its copycat abilities throttled recently .

news.title: GTA 6 预载、全球发布时间和安装规模已确认，Rockstar 公布实体封面艺术海报和列奥尼达地图
news.summary: Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload and global release times, as well as the install size of the ga

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/image001-1-1793719333110.jpg
Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload and global release times as well as the install size of the game.

Digital preloading on PS5 kicks off at midnight local time in your respective timezone on Tuesday, November 10, Rockstar said . On Xbox Series X and S it’s slightly different — preloading begins on Tuesday, November 10 at 12am GMT (UK time). That's 4pm PT and 7pm ET on November 9. Code-in-box versions for both consoles “should” be available from retailers beginning November 12, Rockstar added.
Rockstar has also now officially confirmed that GTA 6 itself launches globally on November 19, using the local midnight release timing strategy across PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
GTA 6 preload global release times:
PS5
Xbox Series X and S
GTA 6 global release times on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S:

As for the install size, Rockstar confirmed that the preload file weighs in at up to 212 GB, “depending on your device.” “So make sure you've got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible,” Rockstar said.

Elsewhere, Rockstar said that on November 19, the day GTA 6 comes out, it will add an official printable GTA 6 cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site. A double-sided physical version of this poster will also be made available shortly after launch from the Rockstar Store — for $0.99 on its own or as a free gift with any purchase from the Rockstar Store.

We’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 while you wait for its November 19 release date, including an unlikely gameplay reveal in the latest episode of South Park , how GTA 6 named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme , and how GTA 6's map will open up relatively early and let you explore freely .

news.title: 官宣！网易停止投资 名越工作室走向解散

content.v: 据日本11月2日官报，由著名制作人 名越稔洋 （代表作《如龙》系列）带队、曾获网易投资的名越工作室（Nagoshi Studio）在10月31日正式决议解散。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4892634_9244286.jpg
名越稔洋在2021年从世嘉离职并建立了名越工作室，在2022年正式官宣加入网易游戏，工作室旗下有一款黑帮题材在研产品《 GANG OF DRAGON 》。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4892634_9244288.gif
《GANG OF DRAGON》在2025年TGA上正式首曝，请来了知名韩国演员马东锡出演游戏主角申志成 （Shin Ji-seong） ，将在以巨大歓楽街歌舞伎町为代表的新宿街头，展开热血澎湃的人间故事。截至撰稿时间，《GANG OF DRAGON》公开了Steam商店页面，宣传图中可见到拳脚格斗、刀剑、枪械、投掷物、载具武器等战斗玩法。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4892634_9244287.jpg
但好景不长，据彭博社报道，因发现该项目至少还需要70亿日元 （约3亿元人民币） ，网易在今年3月份通知名越工作室，将在5月起停止对名越工作室的资助。此后，名越稔洋曾经试图寻求新融资，但最终无果。
如今工作室正式决议解散，这段故事也终于走到了结局。

news.summary: Confirming a recent report, Bethesda has confirmed the subtitle of the next Elder Scrolls game as The Elder Sc

content.v: Confirming a recent report, Bethesda has confirmed the subtitle of the next Elder Scrolls game as The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel . This was shared as part of a 40-year-anniversary video recapping many of Bethesda's highlights over the year.

Unfortunately, that's all that was shared about the game, though we did get a (very familiar-looking) title card showing the game's name in the classic Elder Scrolls font. Bethesda subsequently shared a video with a scroll emerging from the sand, which you can see below.

The one hint of what might await in the game was a quote that follows the name reveal. It's attributed to Yazar, Moth Priest of High Queen Iradne of Hammerfell in 4E 206: "The scroll offered only a shimmer, a veil thinly lifted to my eyes. A future lost. A victory undone. Sands of time scattered by fate."

Two details stick out there: the reference to a scroll and Hammerfell. A recent report from The Verge stated that Elder Scrolls VI will be set in Hammerfell and focus on the history of the titular Elder Scrolls and discovering their secrets. A follow-up tweet from Bethesda states that the game's location has been revealed, so it seems we are indeed headed to Hammerfell.
More notably, Bethesda says it'll "be some time" before more is shared, so don't expect this announcement to signal the beginning of a proper marketing campaign or anything of the sort.

The Elder Scrolls VI was announced way back in 2018, at a time that Bethesda boss Todd Howard later admitted was not his preference . Virtually nothing has been shared about the game since that debut trailer, including any imagery, hence the reason we've all seen that mountain range countless times in the eight-plus years since.

Earlier this year, it was revealed that the majority of Bethesda Game Studios staff are at work on the game , with Howard saying, “We know we need to get it right and it’s been a long time." The last core entry in the series, Skyrim, released in 2011, meaning it will be more than a 15-year gap between new games.

No release date or platforms for The Elder Scrolls VI have been announced, although Bethesda's parent company, Xbox, has faced renewed pressure to turn its business around. In part, that will involve focusing on its biggest franchises , with Fallout 5 also in the works , though Bethesda devs are said to fear further layoffs .

news.title: 购买 GTA 6 可以节省 5,000 美元，或者至少这个人是这么认为的
news.summary: Self-made millionaire Mark Tilbury has shared some advice for how buying GTA 6 can actually save you $5,000. J

content.v: Self-made millionaire Mark Tilbury has shared some advice for how buying GTA 6 can actually save you $5,000. Just don't take this too seriously.

Here's how he arrived at that number: If the game costs $100 (for the Ultimate Edition) and it takes 80 hours to complete, that works out to $1.25/hour of "fun." After adding on side missions and simply exploring GTA 6's map, investing in the game seems like an even better deal at just 50 cents of fun per hour.
If you play for four hours every evening, that's 50 nights of entertainment. Tilbury said people should compare this to a night out where they could easily spend $100 in a night.
"That's why buying GTA 6 actually saves you $5,000," Tilbury says.

Even if it's not a full $100, Tilbury is spot-on that going out to do most things today costs a pretty penny. So staying in to play GTA 6 may indeed "save" you some money you might have spent elsewhere. You may also play a lot of GTA 6 and continue to go out and spend money on other things.
His math also might be conservative, as people are no doubt going to play GTA 6 for far more than 50 days, especially when GTA Online 2.0 releases in 2027, as expected.
Clearly, though, Tilbury is being cheeky here and created the clip for virality and for people to send to their friends and partners to justify how much they are going to play GTA 6.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and a PC edition is expected to be released in 2027.

news.title: 《影之刃零》爆火还藏着一个推手！幕后大功臣

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244235.jpg
「中国含量」越来越高。
文/大田
《影之刃零》发售后的第一个周末很疯狂。游戏发售后72小时全平台销量突破400万，登顶了Steam全球畅销榜，同时在线峰值超过83万——这是今年发售的单机游戏中，Steam在线人数最高的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244234.jpg
在PlayStation上，游戏首日进入了多个国家的畅销榜前十。主机官方也没闲着，在游戏发售当天，他们发布了一支何润东出演的视频，在上海豫园办了一场舞狮活动，邀请中国BOY在西安大唐不夜城现场游玩，在北京开展主题路演，全国的Sony Store也开启了《影之刃零》体验活动……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244240.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244236.jpg
一位为平台做游戏引进的朋友跟我感叹：真让PlayStation捡到宝了。
但如果你关注过《影之刃零》一直以来的宣发，就会知道，这块宝他们押了很久，几乎是不遗余力地给了《影之刃零》宣发资源。
2023年，《影之刃零》的全球首曝就放在了PlayStation发布会上。今年8月，游戏又拿到了一场近20分钟的State of Play专场，在官方YouTube和Twitch频道面向全球直播，这是首个国产游戏State of Play专场。
在PlayStation中国的B站账号上，这场回放在12小时内播放量就超过了219万，成了账号历史上播放最高的视频。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244237.jpg
这个视频目前的播放量已经超过1200万
上个月，主机官方又在重庆鹅岭贰厂做了一轮线下活动：先是10日在园区放出江湖主题的倒计时，之后在19日揭晓了《影之刃零》的巨型涂鸦。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244238.gif
他们为游戏造势到这种程度，以至于海外媒体专门写了篇报道，标题就是《索尼正在中国卖力营销影零》 （Sony's Marketing the Hell Out of PS5 Console Exclusive Phantom Blade Zero in China） 。
当然，他们愿意这样投入，和《影之刃零》本身的产品力分不开。但如果把目光放得更广一点，你会发现，《影之刃零》并非孤例，这台主机上的中国游戏正在变得越来越多。
简单举几个例子：去年11月，网易《燕云十六声》在PS5全球上线；今年5月，《明末：渊虚之羽》进入PS Plus月度会免；9月，中国之星项目《达巴：水痕之地》在State of Play日本场定档2027年春。
相信你也能看出来，PlayStation已经不局限于只为中国游戏做上架、发行了，它和中国团队的合作的方式正变得越来越多样。
露脸越发频繁的中国游戏
今天，PlayStation上突出中国文化要素的游戏，已经相当多了。
除了前面提到的几款，还有讲唐末沙州信使的《归唐》；「中国之星计划」的在研项目中也有不少，比如以古丝绸之路为舞台的《楼兰》，以明代锦衣卫为题材的《代号：锦衣卫》……这个单子可以列很长。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244242.jpg
记得过去聊国产游戏出海，常常有人会提出：中国题材海外玩家看不懂。怎么现在大伙好像都不太担心这件事了？
究其原因，一方面，先行者的成绩，会给开发者带来更多信心，也会让海外玩家对中国游戏有更浓厚的兴趣；另一方面，随着开发能力提升，开发者越来越能把文化融进游戏体验里，而不只是贴在表面。
很有意思的一点是，如果看一下这些游戏的品类，你会发现动作游戏特别多。去年，索尼互动娱乐 （上海） 有限公司游戏制作总监包波曾提到，投递「中国之星计划」的产品里，80%是动作游戏。
这就引出了一个更为关键的原因：动作游戏非常容易跨过文化隔阂。
天美J3总经理Leo在复盘《三角洲行动》时曾告诉我：出海成功的产品，往往既能提供熟悉感，又能提供陌生感。
要说熟悉感这一块，动作可能是海外玩家最喜欢的品类。根据Sensor Tower统计，2025年下半年到2026年上半年，在Steam、PlayStation、Xbox三大平台上，动作都是收入最高的买断制游戏品类。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244239.jpg
中国动作游戏实际上就是在海外玩家对动作品类的熟悉感上，增加了中国文化要素的陌生感——像《影之刃零》中非常出圈的舞狮尊主Boss，就是如此。
而当海外玩家被这种陌生感吸引，深入体验中国动作游戏，get到这些游戏内核之后，往往又会发现这些内核是相通的。
很多出海的中国动作游戏都会发现，虽然海外玩家未必懂中国历史典故，也未必能分清所有文化符号，但家国情怀、侠义精神这些精神内核，只要有优质的玩法和故事支撑，其实可以跨过障碍，让海外玩家也受到感染。
比如《燕云十六声》发行负责人就曾经告诉我，他们担心玩家很难理解河西剧情，但后来发现，很多海外主播玩到河西时都哭了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244241.jpg
在他看来，河西讲的是一个人对家的探索，而海外有许多移民二代、三代，所以这个故事在他们那里能引起共鸣。他得出的结论是：人的底层情绪无非是生老病死、爱别离苦，海外用户可能表达方式不同，但人的情绪是相通的。
《影之刃零》也有类似的经验，制作人梁其伟曾告诉我，海外媒体和玩家会把主角魂比作John Wick，一个想退出江湖、却不得不回到江湖的人。他觉得，虽然海外玩家与中国文化有隔阂，但不妨碍他们理解这种内核精神。
动作品类有这么强的跨文化能力，而恰好在这方面，中国有充足的基因优势——有太多武术、民俗和武打人才，可以和游戏开发团队合作。
《影之刃零》就很好地利用了这一点。除了请到甄子丹深度参与游戏的功夫风格及动作设计指导外，一些Boss战设计背后也花了不少心思：
比如七星剑阵这场Boss战，团队找到峨眉武术国家级非遗传承人王超取经，把峨眉剑避实就虚、攻防转换极快的特点拆解成核心动作，再重组成了剑阵里每个敌人的招式，配合上多人动捕和群体AI控制阵型，这场Boss战非常有观赏性。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244244.gif
不仅是《影之刃零》这样的3A动作游戏会这样做，像《燕云十六声》这类武侠主题、不同品类的游戏，也会用到类似的资源，游戏中的伞类武器，就是请拿过香港电影金像奖和金马奖的董玮担任动作指导完成的。
现在，高品质玩法和中国故事的组合正在被越来越多团队验证，这至少说明，海外玩家不必先熟悉中国历史和典故，也能被玩法吸引、被故事打动。对开发者来说，接下来要解决的，就是怎样更多地接触海外玩家。
更加深入的合作
如何接触海外玩家，这个问题梁其伟曾经和我们聊过。
他把出海分成两种，一种是手游常见的「收益国际化」：靠买量和数据优化在海外赚钱，本质是一套ROI算法；另一种是「高级国际化」：做品牌——海外玩家知道你的公司，知道你做过什么，会去扒你的历史，会因为游戏做得不好去骂你这个制作人。
在他看来，单机游戏不可能通过买量的方式来发行，它面对的是一群不分国界的核心玩家，要被他们接受，就必须进入他们的主流叙事体系里，成为全球主机文化的一部分。
而这一步，往往需要平台来帮一把。
一年多前，我还在感叹ChinaJoy上PlayStation展区的「全华班」，那时我看到的，是中国游戏在PlayStation上越来越显眼；而现在，PlayStation正在更主动地把中国游戏推到全球玩家面前。
不可否认的是，PlayStation本身巨大的市场基础，对产品来说已经是一种助力。
海外的核心玩家，很大一部分在主机上。Video Games Europe的数据显示，在2024年的调查对象中，59%的玩家在主机上玩游戏。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4755670_9244243.jpg
此外，Sensor Tower统计了2025年下半年到2026年上半年Steam、PlayStation、Xbox三大平台的买断制游戏收入，总计300亿美元，其中PlayStation占了45.1%；动作品类收入在PlayStation上达到48.1亿美元，比Steam还多出7亿多美元。
这意味着，愿意为动作游戏掏出真金白银的玩家，有相当一部分在PlayStation上。
《影之刃零》的预购数据也能印证这种印象。据Alinea Analytics估算，游戏截至10月27日的数字版预购中，Steam上有约四分之三来自中国；到了PS5上，中国预购数就只占24.9%，剩下四分之三的预购来自其他地区。
梁其伟当年答应去PlayStation发布会首曝，理由之一也是「喜欢我们这个玩法的游戏群体，确实在PlayStation平台多一些」。
但反过来说，索尼互动娱乐 （Sony Interactive Entertainment，简称SIE） 也需要中国团队和中国游戏。

news.title: 美女声优cosplay疑"种族歧视"！被欧美网友集体出征

content.v: 万圣节刚过，不知道鸡友们有没有cosplay些什么去凑凑热闹呢？
每年的这个时候又是一年一度的cos大赏，在网上总会涌现出各种极具创意的cosplay。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271634.jpg
而姬今年也出cos了，不过cos的是“穷鬼”，也算是本色演出了。
不过也不是什么东西都能随便cos的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271630.jpg
特别是在欧美地区，有关种族的议题这块就异常地敏感，说不定哪天就无端端踩进坑里去了。
最近日本的一位偶像声优反田叶月，就因为万圣节出cos而摊上事了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271633.jpg
反田叶月曾为《Ave Mujica》的纯田真奈配音，在圈子里有着一定的知名度。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271635.jpg
而在前两天的万圣节，她cos了《小羊肖恩》里的绵羊，看上去非常沙雕、魔性。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271632.jpg
这里麻烦各位把视线请往上挪一点，因为这次让她引起争议的，可不是她的黑丝，而是她那涂黑的脸。
之前就给鸡友们科普过，从200多年前开始，欧美地区就流行过白人把脸涂黑假扮黑人来取悦观众的表演。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271631.jpg
虽然这样的表演早已不复存在，但这种涂黑脸的操作，在欧美地区依然属于严重的种族歧视行为。
无独有偶，今年年初也发生过类似的事。
当时一位coser扮演了阿布嘟嘟，也因为一毛一样的理由被欧美网友冲了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271638.jpg
不过这次反田叶月除了涂黑脸，她的cos服上还有假装是羊毛的棉花。
棉花这玩意也和黑人族群的历史，有着莫大的渊源。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271648.jpg
而她手上还拿着香蕉，也容易让人联想到黑人经常被骂是猩猩或猴子。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271636.jpg
所以这一套组合拳下来，自然也导致不少欧美网友应激了，质疑她是在对黑人种族歧视，并对她进行各种攻击。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271643.jpg
她另一只手还拿着葱呢，你们咋不说那是公主殿下呢？
这真的是人在家坐，锅从天上来，哪怕是再怎么光明磊落的人，都会怕有心人去做阅读理解。
然而事实是她手里拿的香蕉和葱，分别代表了《小羊肖恩》里的农夫和大黄狗比泽尔，这是他们的代表色。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271644.jpg
至于她为什么cos这个，大概率是因为今年《小羊肖恩》的大电影，在日本引起了热潮，才会让反田叶月决定扮成绵羊登场。
哪怕她发的第三张图就是小羊肖恩，说明了cos的对象，但这对于那些欧美网友来说也并不重要。
他们只是一味地去扣帽子，一味地输出，说是魔怔也不为过。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/03/origin_6732209_9271642.jpg
虽然她目前对这事没有发表任何声明，不过大部分网友们都对她表示支持，同时也为她进行辩解。
有网友就表示为什么涂黑，是因为她cos的羊本来就是黑的，真的要冲那就要先把《小羊肖恩》原作者给冲了吧。
《小羊肖恩》创作者：？
还有网友直接就用魔法对付魔法：
如果看到棉花和香蕉就联想到黑人，这就说明你才是种族歧视的那个~
面对那些胡闹的人，这招还真的永不过时。
当然，也有一小拨网友像山鸡那样，只知道一边吃瓜一边盯着她的cos照流口水的。
他们到底是对叶月的黑丝还是小羊肖恩感兴趣，这个还有待考究。
至于她这番操作到底算不算歧视，其实每个人心里都有自己的答案。
不过，这件事也再次证明，一旦先入为主地给人贴上标签，想要改变对方的固有印象就难如登天。
因为在这种情况下，有些人根本不是来讨论问题的，而是单纯想找个机会疯狂输出。
既然如此，再多的解释也只是对牛弹琴，沟通自然也就失去了意义。
所以说，清者自清，鸡友们也千万别轻易掉进自证的陷阱，毕竟，你永远叫不醒一个只想装睡的人。

news.title: 《午夜之南》导演表示他不会资助这款游戏
news.summary: Xbox funded and published 2025's South of Midnight, a highly acclaimed action-adventure game set in the Americ

content.v: Xbox funded and published 2025's South of Midnight, a highly acclaimed action-adventure game set in the American Deep South. The game's creative director, David Sears, said he believes South of Midnight is a "generational" game that he hopes people discover and play for a long time and one that he thought would help elevate the "prestige" of Xbox.

At the same time, Sears said he wasn't sure Microsoft's spending spree under the previous leaders Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond--which is how Sears' studio Compulsion got the funding to make South of Midnight--was going to work out long term.

"I literally told people, I was like, 'Yeah, wow, this could be terrible.' Because somebody is going to say, someday, 'The money tap ... we're closing those floodgates.' And that's going to have really traumatic results downstream," he told Ben Hanson on MinnMax .

Microsoft spent billions and billions of dollars to buy studios and franchises to help get Xbox Game Pass off the ground. The bet did not work out , and now Spencer and Bond are out. The new Xbox CEO is Asha Sharma, and one of her first moves was to cut costs dramatically with layoffs, studio divestures--including Compulsion--and game cancellations. Sharma also talked about how Game Pass needs to evolve into something that's "more enticing to a broader range of customers.”
Asked directly if he had been in control of the Xbox funding at the time, would Sears have stopped writing checks for games like South of Midnight? "Yeah, probably," he answered ( via Kotaku ).

"I wanted to make it. No doubt. Obviously. Because we made it. Would I have turned off someone else’s money flow before South of Midnight? Yeah. Because I’m not completely selfless. It just seems like, in hindsight at least, it was unsustainable," Sears said.

A lot of people said Microsoft's spending on Xbox Game Pass was unsustainable and ultimately going to lead to pain and turmoil. Raphael Colantonio, the co-founder of Arkane, said Game Pass is unsustainable and "increasingly damaging" to the industry. Game Pass has been propped up by Microsoft's "infinite money," Colantonio said.

Raccoon Logic studio head Alex Hutchinson spoke out about Game Pass devaluing games earlier this year after his game Revenge of the Savage Planet was a day-one title on Xbox Game Pass. Conversely, Rebellion touted the launch of Atomfall on Game Pass as a huge success for the company.

With Microsoft's big bets not panning out in the way the company envisioned, the Xbox business struggled, and the ensuing Xbox "reset" has been painful for the people, teams, and fans of Xbox. Sears said hindsight is 20/20, but he always had a feeling that things just weren't right and that the bottom could fall out one day in terms of Xbox's spending spree.

"Of course it was going to have a 'shocking' outcome. It’s easy to dissect it now. But at the time ... I would talk to other directors and [they’d] be like, 'How is this happening? How did we get so lucky? Is this a golden era?' And I would always be like ... 'For now,'" he said. "And there’s always a night when Rome burns. I didn’t know exactly when it would be, but I was always worried about it."
Sears went on to say the Microsoft of today is "much more humane" than the company was in the '90s and 2000s, something he said is "remarkable and commendable."

Sears said it's a good thing that Microsoft is allowing studios it wants to let go of get spun out instead of shutting them down outright. Compulsion, for its part, was among the studios that got spun out, and is now operating independently and seeking new projects and funding sources .

South of Midnight originally launched for Xbox and PC in April 2025, later coming to PS5 and Switch 2 in March 2026. Now that Compulsion is independent, buying the game supports the studio directly, and not Xbox .

Throughout all of the downturns at Xbox, Microsoft continues to make gigantic sums of money, in part because Xbox represents just a tiny sliver of the company's overall business. For the latest quarter, Microsoft made $92.3 billion in revenue (up 19%) and a profit of $36.6 billion (up 32%). Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has praised Sharma for gutting the Xbox business so heavily .

news.title: 冯骥暗示《黑神话：钟馗》剧情基调：并不简单！
news.summary: 近日，《黑神话》系列制作人在与网友互动时，隐晦回应了新作《黑神话：钟馗》的剧情走向。

content.v: 近日，《黑神话》系列制作人在与网友互动时，隐晦回应了新作《黑神话：钟馗》的剧情基调。
有网友在评论区留言询问：“冯总，钟馗的剧情会不会轻松一些了，这几年感觉游戏剧情都苦大仇深的。”针对这一提问，制作人冯骥并没有明确给出结论，而是回复了一个“并不简单”的表情。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031007568606.png
这一表情互动随即引发玩家关注，外界普遍将其解读为一种暗示，意味着《黑神话：钟馗》的剧情基调大概率不会轻松，依然会延续一定的复杂与沉重感。
目前，官方尚未公布该作的具体剧情细节，更多信息仍有待后续揭晓。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031008046529.png

news.title: 《魔兽:无限》需预留150GB！预载开启 5日全球开服
news.summary: 据IGN报道，《魔兽世界：无限》的预载已经开启，暴雪也把全球解锁时间摆上了台面：太平洋时间11月4日下午3点，换算到北京时间为11月…

content.v: 据IGN报道，《魔兽世界：无限》的预载已经开启，暴雪也把全球解锁时间摆上了台面：太平洋时间11月4日下午3点，换算到北京时间为11月5日早7点。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/03/cas_auto/small_0_9258346.jpg
暴雪确认本作采用全球统一发布，各地玩家在同一时刻进入服务器，没有哪个地区能提前数小时甚至一天推进进度，首日冲级、抢首杀和资源争夺都从同一条起跑线开始。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/03/cas_auto/small_0_9258374.jpg
配置门槛同样需要提前确认。报道转述暴雪系统需求称，游戏至少需要128GB可用空间，且明确要求SSD；最低配置为4核3GHz处理器、8GB内存和DirectX 12 capable的4GB显卡，推荐配置则来到8核、16GB内存和8GB显卡。
IGN编辑还建议预留约150GB，给首日就会出现的插件留出余地。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/03/cas_auto/small_0_9258375.jpg

news.title: 《影之刃零》斩马刀竟不让按着沐小葵吸 太可惜了
news.summary: 然而，近日有玩家发帖提出了一个疑问：同样是小体型人型BOSS，为什么第三章关底的沐小葵不能触发亡命斩马刀的这套吸血动作？

content.v: 在《影之刃零》第二章击败BOSS荆野后，玩家可以获得他的武器“亡命斩马刀”。这把武器攻击自带吸血效果，消耗精纯杀气发动绝技时，主角“魂”会将斩马刀砍向敌人肩膀，强行压制大量人型或小体型敌人，随后按住对方吸血。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031411428039.png
如果面对的是大体型敌人，绝技则会变成多次连续斩击，吸血效果同样相当可观。
然而，近日有玩家发帖提出了一个疑问：同样是小体型人型BOSS，为什么第三章关底的沐小葵不能触发这套吸血动作？明明斩马刀面对其他敌人都能正常发动，到了小葵这里却不管用了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031411585916.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031412332592.png
评论区玩家很快给出了各种猜测和玩笑。有人表示，这属于游戏对特殊角色的动作限制，除了沐小葵，玩由甄子丹扮演的金面具黑衣人BOSS，也无法触发这一绝技。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031416046328.png
还有玩家调侃：“人家小情侣打情骂俏，你玩真的啊？”也有人解释，游戏显然是故意限制了部分凶残动作，不会让它们在小葵身上触发，毕竟两人是师徒关系，战斗更像是在切磋。

news.title: 玩家通关《影之刃零》等“2” 没想到都停服了
news.summary: 有玩家通关《影之刃零》之后，认为故事没讲完，并期待《影之刃2》，而这也引发了一些笑料，因为《影之刃2》早就出过了。

content.v: 由你来说： 有玩家通关《影之刃零》之后，认为故事没讲完，并期待《影之刃2》，而这也引发了一些笑料，因为《影之刃2》早就出过了。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611030946197822.jpg
下文涉及轻微剧透！！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611030946061362.png
《影之刃零》发售后，已经有不少硬核玩家通关了游戏。近日，有玩家在体验完结局后发文感叹：“肯定会有《影之刃2》吧。故事最后没有讲完，66天最后还剩下50多天，足够再出好几部了。”
然而，这位玩家似乎并不知道，《影之刃》这个IP此前早就推出过《影之刃》和《影之刃2》手游，甚至《影之刃3》至今仍在运营中。
面对期待“2”的玩家，网友们纷纷在评论区调侃：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611030946535905.jpg
有网友表示：“数字标题被梁圣（梁其伟）贷款用完了，下一部大标题大概率是《影之刃壹》或《影之刃贰》。”
也有人无奈指出：“《影之刃2》已经停服了。”
关于未来的命名方式，有玩家预测：“下一步大概率会用《影之刃：XX》或《XXX》来跟手游做区别，还有主体标榜，但真的别再搞网游那套审美的服化道和动画了。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611030947474035.jpg
此外，还有资深玩家表示：“你现在就可以玩《影之刃3》，影一影二已经是时代的眼泪了（不过有单机私服）。”
事实上，开发商灵游坊早年正是凭借单机游戏《雨血》系列起家，后转战手游市场推出了《影之刃》三部曲。此次发售的《影之刃零》则是一部回归单机买断制的大作。
正如网友所言，数字后缀早已被手游占满，未来如果推出续作，或许真的要在命名上颇费一番心思了。

news.title: 国内首款且唯一！国产大作11月24日上线DLSS5
news.summary: 《燕云十六声》官方今日发文，确认游戏将于11月24日正式支持DLSS5。

content.v: 《燕云十六声》官方今日发文，确认游戏将于11月24日正式支持DLSS5。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031709083853.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031523039838.png
11月24日，《燕云十六声》将正式支持NVIDIA DLSS 5 技术，成为全球首批、国内首款且唯一支持该技术的游戏。
官方那个表示，在DLSS 5 的加持下，整个江湖的材质与光影“真实感”表现都将迎来突破性的进化。
11月24日上线的版本，历经英伟达官方多轮专项调优，画面与性能表现间实现了更好的平衡。官方也会继续与英伟达保持紧密技术合作，后续还将持续更新迭代，为游侠带来更好的视觉体验。

news.title: 大尺度《猛鬼追魂》大更新来了！内容超多 更爽体验
news.summary: 《猛鬼追魂：复兴》是由Saber Interactive开发的恐怖游戏，本作于2026年10月8日正式发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S及PC（Steam）平…

content.v: 《猛鬼追魂：复兴》是由Saber Interactive开发的恐怖游戏，本作于2026年10月8日正式发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series X|S及PC（Steam）平台。
近日，《猛鬼追魂：复兴》官方宣布，游戏全新版本大更新现已上线。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032202517475.jpg
具体更新如下：
全平台通用
功能优化
战斗与敌人
敌人现在能更稳定地听见处决动作发出的声响。
游戏玩法
滑行现在会产生噪音，能够被敌人侦测到。
“熄灯” 走廊场景中，强制移动卡顿停止的问题已修复。
音频
在难度选择界面，鼠标悬停在各个难度选项上时，新增一段更有紧张感的音效提示。
用户界面与交互
主菜单新增高对比度显示开关选项。
更新利维坦模型谜题的交互提示，将转动谜题和旋转视角两个操作的提示区分清晰。
更新游戏片尾制作人员名单。
漏洞修复
流程与卡死问题
- 修复游戏后期水淹房间任务中，存档读档后拉杆不刷新、阻断剧情推进的问题。
- 修复玩家在第二次与布鲁诺 BOSS 战时被卡住的 BUG。
- 修复布鲁诺的血液模型穿透闭合大门，导致玩家卡死的问题。
- 修复在死亡界面进行制作操作会造成游戏卡死的 BUG。
- 修复和佐拉商店交互后游戏流程被阻断的问题。
- 修复玩家在俱乐部场景受击硬直后，卡在两张沙发椅子夹缝角落的问题。
- 修复多次重生、读档后，迷宫里喋喋怪的追逐场景加载失败。
- 修复玩家与喋喋怪在迷宫第一场追逐战中双双卡死。
- 修复玩家卡在教堂广场大门后方。
- 修复慈悲修女潜行关卡结束后，玩家首次尝试进入迷宫失败。
- 修复碰撞体问题，导致夏洛特追逐战无法正常通关。
- 修复传送目标加载延迟，玩家从迷宫地图掉出场景外。
- 修复夏洛特 BOSS 战中卡在岩石平台上。
- 修复多电视房间内梯子交互提示消失。
- 修复迷宫里的石柱坍塌，阻挡艾丹继续前进。
- 修复玩家卡在锯片陷阱房间。
- 修复自动存档读档后，侦探尸体处的碰撞阻挡，无法原路返回。
- 修复玩家可突破布鲁诺宅邸的地图边界，跑出可游玩区域。
- 修复游戏后期玩家在教堂外部，被碰撞体困住。
- 修复多处地图模型漏洞，玩家会直接跌落地图外。
战斗与敌人
- 修复 “不洁者” 在门框处被打出硬直时，无法触发净化处决提示。
- 修复拿到地狱锁链房间之后，不洁者身上不出现净化处决提示。
- 修复附近敌人被净化后，其余敌人丧失翻越窗户的能力。
- 修复不洁者会尝试穿墙，从井里攻击玩家。
- 修复霰弹枪对半分尸的不洁者残肢，会在阁楼持续追踪玩家且无法击杀。
- 修复布鲁诺在刺击玩家时出现滑行异常。
- 修复布鲁诺变身血形态的过程会被枪械攻击打断。
- 修复玩家被布鲁诺击杀重生后，布鲁诺不再移动。
- 修复潜行遭遇战时，夏洛特在泛光灯附近出现模型抽搐。
- 修复玩家爬上特定石墙后，夏洛特不会向玩家冲锋。
- 修复喋喋怪第一场追逐时，难以正常走到预设路径上。
- 修复喋喋怪第二次追逐会卡墙，极少数情况可穿墙击杀玩家。
- 修复慈悲修女有时不会在潜行过场动画出场，随后追逐阶段直接击杀玩家。
- 修复邪教徒终结处决动画位置错位，处决完成后原地僵住。
- 修复邪教徒无理由出现迷失方向的异常状态。
- 修复邪教徒会在玩家视野内直接消失。
- 修复邪教徒穿墙播放受击硬直动画。
- 修复邪教徒本该射击玩家却不开火。
- 修复一处小礼拜堂内，男性邪教徒使用女性配音，同时自身会卡住不动。
- 修复重甲邪教徒可以穿到本无法进入的门后。

news.title: 《红沙》娶到酥胸美乳老婆晒性福日常 带她骑大马
news.summary: 此前我们曾报道，一位日本玩家在社交平台分享了自己体验《红色沙漠》新增结婚系统的经历，并晒出成功迎娶游戏内女NPC的画面。

content.v: 此前我们曾报道 ，一位日本玩家在社交平台分享了自己体验《红色沙漠》新增结婚系统的经历，并晒出成功迎娶游戏内女NPC的画面。为了完成结婚流程，他没有使用任何MOD，前后花费约7个小时提升好感度，最终成功抱得美人归。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031426343484.png
近日，这位玩家又晒出了自己的婚后生活。他表示，自从DLC推出以来，自己几乎一直在忙着寻找结婚对象，不过对此感到相当满足。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031427083210.png

news.title: DLSS 5本月支持三款新游戏！包含首款国产大作
news.summary: 英伟达近日公布了DLSS 5技术接下来的落地计划，三款游戏将在11月陆续获得官方支持

content.v: 英伟达近日公布了DLSS 5技术接下来的落地计划，三款游戏将在11月陆续获得官方支持，其中《霍格沃茨之遗》将率先更新。
《霍格沃茨之遗》将于11月5日推送免费更新，成为第二款正式支持DLSS 5的游戏。与六个月前首次展示时引发的争议不同，此次官方实装版本调整了AI模型，在提升环境材质、光照和阴影细节的同时，刻意保留了角色原本的外观，不再出现此前被批评的“AI感”面部变化。根据英伟达的说法，配合路径追踪和6倍多帧生成，RTX 5090在4K下可达最高300帧，但这一数字包含AI生成帧，不等同于原生渲染性能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032156375614.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032156379916.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032156384533.png
《战争雷霆》将在11月中旬的“鹰影”（Eagle‘s Shadow）大型更新中获得DLSS 5支持，改善空战、陆战和海战中的光照、阴影及载具细节。英伟达基于其陆战基准测试声称，在支持硬件上开启光线重建和6倍多帧生成后，4K下可达最高400帧。

news.title: Remedy 在控制谐振上的大赌注似乎得到了回报
news.summary: Following the September release of Control Resonant , business is boomin' for developer Remedy Entertainment.

content.v: Following the September release of Control Resonant , business is boomin' for developer Remedy Entertainment. The studio reported that its third-quarter revenue surged 226% to €39.6 million / $44.3 million after the game's release, following the financial review period on October 15, a feat CEO Jean-Charles Gaudechon called "a defining milestone" for Remedy.

In terms of operating profit, Remedy said it made €0.6 million / $670,794, and while that may not sound like much, it's still better than the €16.4 million / $18.3 million loss the studio posted in the same quarter last year. Control Resonant has sold over 1 million units, making it Remedy's fastest-selling title to date, with most sales coming from the US. The game has also been popular in the US and the UK, and Remedy says that half of the players were new to the franchise.

"Reaching new players was a key goal for this game, and these early results indicate a growing audience for the franchise and for Remedy," Gaudechon said, adding that the developer is looking to get the game into the hands of more people. Control Resonant's predecessor, Control, also saw increased sales, and that financial runway will help Remedy as it continues working on other projects, like its Max Payne 1 & 2 remake. Gaudechon also noted that Control Resonant is currently on 2.4 million wishlists, which could provide a "substantial potential audience" for the future.

"Excellent player reviews, penetration in all our target markets and a substantial outstanding wishlist base give a solid foundation for the game’s longer-term sales potential, supported by both organic visibility as well as our targeted marketing activities," said Gaudechon. As for the other games in the Remedy catalog, Gaudechon said that most people are playing FBC: Firebreak through subscription services like Game Pass or PlayStation Plus, and in its second year, it is making less money. The Alan Wake franchise had a quieter quarter, but the Alan Wake 2 capitalized development costs were fully depreciated during Q3.
For more on Control Resonant, read up on how different it is from its predecessor, why you have to watch out for scary buses , and the cool little details lurking in the background.

news.title: 《走近科学》停播多年再度走红！飞机排泄物变“天外飞仙”
news.summary: 《走近科学》当年希望通过破解怪事、解释现象来普及科学知识，本身的出发点并没有问题。问题在于，它太依赖“先制造悬念，再揭晓答…

content.v: 央视科普节目《走近科学》早在2019年就已停播，如今却因为网友翻出过去的荒诞案例，再度成为热门话题。从飞机排泄物坠落被包装成“天降陨冰”，到内裤掉色被渲染成“睾丸变蓝怪病”，节目常常先用悬疑甚至恐怖的方式制造紧张感，最后再揭晓一个平淡无奇的真相。如今再看，这些曾经严肃播出的内容，反而成了网友眼中的喜剧素材。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032134577448.jpg
编辑观点： 《走近科学》当年希望通过破解怪事、解释现象来普及科学知识，本身的出发点并没有问题。问题在于，它太依赖“先制造悬念，再揭晓答案”的叙事套路。
观众原本是为了获得科学解释而打开节目，时间久了，却逐渐变成了猜测结局到底有多离谱。“吐血奇人实为牙龈炎”“不眠妇女其实睁眼睡觉”等案例被反复传播，也让“没走进过科学”成了对节目最具代表性的调侃。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032135034349.jpg
这种反差也解释了节目为什么会在停播多年后重新走红：当年为了吸引观众而设计的悬疑桥段，如今脱离原本的播出环境，被网友剪辑、讨论和二次传播，反而产生了意想不到的娱乐效果。
但热度回归不等于口碑翻盘。观众现在觉得好笑，恰恰可能是因为节目曾经把普通现象包装得过于神秘，让科普内容失去了应有的严谨与可信度。
《走近科学》于2019年因央视科教频道整体改版停播，并非单纯因为网友今天讨论的这些案例。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032135101713.jpg
与其把它的停播简单归结为“节目太搞笑”，不如反思科普内容究竟应该怎样吸引观众：悬念可以有，故事也可以讲，但不能为了制造戏剧性而让科学解释沦为最后的配角。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032135209259.jpg
需要厘清的是，《走近科学》停播源自央视科教频道的整体改版，并非直接因为如今网上流传的这些搞笑段子。一档科普节目的衰落，也给当下内容创作者留下值得深思的命题：悬念和故事可以作为吸引观众的敲门砖，但万万不能本末倒置，为了博眼球牺牲科学本身。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032135281939.jpg
你对《走近科学》印象最深的是哪一集？你觉得做科普节目，讲故事和讲真相哪个更重要？欢迎在评论区分享你的看法。

news.title: Helldivers 2：新的有毒终结者类型，虫洞在银河系中生成
news.summary: Attention, Helldivers. The Ministry of Truth confirms that a new Terminid strain is skittering across the fron

content.v: Attention, Helldivers. The Ministry of Truth confirms that a new Terminid strain is skittering across the front lines. Designated the Noxious strain, these menaces are fast, venomous, and fundamentally opposed to Managed Democracy.
Worse still, the bugs have been digging. Terminid cave networks now course beneath more biomes in the galaxy from scorched deserts to frozen tundras. Every planet may have a hive beneath it.
Here is everything a Helldiver needs to know courtesy of the Ministry of Truth:
At first glance these resemble ordinary Scavengers. Their additional vileness becomes more apparent when they skitter in to attack.

Noxious Scavengers are noticeably quicker than their cousins which makes them hard to keep in your sights. Every bite delivers a deadly dose of poison and they are ready to bite again almost immediately. Fortunately, they are fragile. Weapons that reward volume over precision such as shotguns, flamethrowers, and grenades, will make short work of them. Super Earth reminds you that ammunition is cheaper than antivenom.

Forget everything you know about Spewers dragging themselves across the ground. The Noxious Spewer is a hulking monstrosity that moves with unsettling speed and it is responsible for the webs now draped across the battlefield.

At medium range, watch for its Web Spit . One hit and you lose the ability to sprint, which is exactly what the abomination wants: to slow its prey and close the gap. Beware its bite, which is quick, has surprising reach, and carries a stronger dose of venom than anything a Scavenger can deliver.

While its head is protected by medium armor, its web-filled abdomen has no armor at all. Be cautious when targeting this location, as when the sac bursts in a Web Explosion , it will snare every Helldiver and bug nearby. Super Earth recommends not being caught in the explosion.

Every Noxious bite inflicts poison, which can cripple the Democratic spirit of even the most stalwart Helldivers. You can track your condition with the new poison icon on your HUD. Super Earth categorizes the poisoning as follows:

Lightly poisoned: Your vision starts to haze, the poison begins to eat away at your health Heavily poisoned: Damage over time increases, you lose the ability to sprint, your vision hazes, Lady Liberty comes to visit you
Thankfully, your stims will help cure your condition, so ration them wisely. A poisoned squadmate may need that stim to keep going and fulfill your mission

The Terminids have gone underground and Super Earth is hunting them down. Bug caves are no longer limited to a handful of worlds; they now have a chance to appear across more biomes on the Galactic map.

Inside these tunnels sightlines are short, corners are blind, and fast enemies arrive before you hear them. Absolutely ideal territory for those Noxious bugs. Bring close-range firepower, stay with your squad, and keep a stim in reserve for whoever wandered too far ahead.
The Noxious strain want the galaxy wrapped in silk and soaked in venom. Super Earth has other plans, and those plans involve you.
Pack your stims, aim for the abdomen, and remember: arachnophobia is not a recognized exemption from military service. See you in the caves, Helldiver. For Super Earth!

news.title: “当世界上发生不好的事情时，恐怖总是最强烈的”——《寂静岭》重制版的老板 Dev Bloober 揭示了他的工作室成功的秘诀
news.summary: Bloober Team certainly appears to be the busiest horror studio in the business right now. Off the back of its

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/05/27/untitled-1-copy-1666187781885-1716851975081.jpg

Bloober Team certainly appears to be the busiest horror studio in the business right now. Off the back of its 2024 Silent Hill 2 remake selling over 5 million copies, the Polish developer currently has a staggering seven horror games in various stages of production. During Gamescom Asia x Thailand Game Show in Bangkok last week, IGN sat down with Bloober Team CEO Piotr Babieno to get an insight into the secrets to his studio’s success, its ambitious plans for the future, and why horror has become such a bankable genre in recent years.

“I would say that horror is always at its strongest when something bad is happening to the world,” said Babieno. “When we have climate changes, when we have wars, [or] when we have some economical issues in the world. This is the moment when society [has] some kind of fear inside.”

“That’s why horror movies, horror novels, and horror games are working so well," he continued. "It’s working for horror, but I’m not happy about it because it always means that the world is not in good shape.”

Babieno is obviously not wrong. Humanity is currently faced with a global cost of living crisis, increasingly volatile weather events, ongoing wars between Russia and Ukraine and the U.S. and Iran, and the existential threat posed by the rapidly accelerating adoption of AI across virtually every major industry.

At the same time, the horror genre has rarely been hotter across most entertainment mediums. Indie horror films Backrooms and Obsession became major success stories at the box office earlier this year, with the latter going on to make over half a billion dollars. The Resident Evil series continues to be one of the most dominant brands in the genre, with its latest video game instalment Resident Evil Requiem selling 8.5 million copies since its launch in February, and its latest big screen adaptation from Weapons director Zach Cregger quickly becoming the highest-grossing Resident Evil movie ever .

The surging popularity of spooks and scares has also spread to many popular streaming services. Mike Flanagan’s adaptation of Stephen King’s Carrie performing strong enough on Prime Video in order to be renewed for a second season . Friday the 13th prequel series Crystal Lake has apparently become one of Peacock’s biggest scripted original series. Meanwhile Apple’s Widows Bay is one of the most celebrated TV shows of the year – horror or otherwise – snaring a whopping 14 Emmy Awards in September.

Even comic book movies are turning to the genre, with the DCU’s thoroughly disturbing Clayface enjoying a strong opening weekend in October . Public domain characters have also proved to be ripe for the picking, with two Winnie the Pooh slasher movies already released and a third one on the way in January .

However, Bloober Team is no bandwagon-jumper. Although the foundational years of the studio were spent producing a mix of casual games and contract work, the developer has been singularly focussed on becoming a specialist house of horror since it launched Layers of Fear in 2016. In the decade since, Bloober has steadily risen to become one of the most trusted conjurers of fear and dread in videogames, proving to be equally adept at reimagining licensed properties as it is at establishing new IPs of its own.

“There are a lot of great horror game developers in the world; we are one of them,” said Babieno. “We’re trying to focus [purely] on creating horror so that’s why the iteration process allows us to work not just on the formula [for creating fear], but on the technological aspect of creating games.”

“Also understanding our fans. Understanding what we did wrong and how we could improve. Project by project we are always thinking, ‘is this the next step for the studio? Is this the next step for our fans?’ Because if it’s not, you don’t want to waste four years of your life creating a new title.”

While Babieno’s team has become attuned to listening to its dedicated fanbase, it’s also learned to ignore its detractors online. Not unlike the undeserved backlash that Zach Cregger was forced to endure prior to the release of his Resident Evil movie , Bloober Team faced plenty of scrutiny from Silent Hill diehards when it was hard at work remaking Silent Hill 2. However, Babieno makes it clear that his team had complete confidence in their ability to reimagine the Konami classic to a standard that would be embraced by even its harshest of critics.

“At the beginning we suffered a lot of hate from fans,” said Babieno. “But we did the one thing which any studio who is trying to create something great is able to do: focus on the project, focus on delivering the best quality game, and put the noise around it out of our head.”
“So this is what we tried to do; we believed from the very beginning that we’d be able to achieve this and it happened. Silent Hill 2 was a pivot point for Bloober Team.”

Silent Hill 2’s subsequent critical and commercial success is likely a big part of the reason that Bloober Team now finds itself in such hot demand and experiencing a period of expansion at a time when so many other studios in the industry are suffering cuts and closures. Bloober Team is currently composed of two first-party studios, and has recently added the second-party Broken Mirror Games, a label that it uses to co-develop games with five other Polish development teams. A remake of the original Silent Hill, Layers of Fear 3, Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive Onyx: The Dark Grip, and Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, a psychological horror game set in Gene Roddenberry’s beloved sci-fi universe, are four of the seven games currently in development that have been confirmed so far.

Babieno was unable to comment on the recent Silent Hill leak that suggested it would be released in 2027 and star Gabrielle Fritz and Jade Matthew – when prompted, he dismissed the details as "rumors." He also couldn’t reveal much about Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, other than agreeing with publishing partner Paramount Games Studio’s goals for it to be “the best Star Trek game of all time,” by stating simply that he wouldn’t be working on it if he “didn’t have such a fight.”

However, Babieno was keen to share his enthusiasm for Project H, the working title for the next game from the team behind 2025’s Cronos: The New Dawn. Although according to Babieno the project is only in the late stages of pre-production, he seems confident that it will represent yet another stride forward for the studio.

“This project is like a huge step from Cronos and from our previous titles so it will deliver a new kind of experience,” said Babieno. “But at the same time it will be very familiar to everyone who [has] already played Bloober Team games. So we will still keep our DNA in it, but we will show this in a completely fresh new way.”
Ultimately for Babieno, the ambition for Bloober Team and where it sits in the booming horror genre seems clear.

“I love Silent Hill and Resident Evil, and I feel that there is a place for a third huge horror IP as well,” said Babieno. “I think we’re on the right track with everything we’re creating. You can feel that Bloober Team’s games are a little bit different [to] those that are already available on the market.”

news.title: 《猎天使魔女3》也惨被移植PC！最高4K60帧
news.summary: 近日，开发者Zexyen推出了实验性PC静态重编译项目Witch Time，把原本Switch独占、从未官方登陆PC的《猎天使魔女3》进行原生PC代码转…

content.v: 近日，开发者Zexyen推出了实验性PC静态重编译项目Witch Time，把原本Switch独占、从未官方登陆PC的《猎天使魔女3》进行原生PC代码转换。项目基于B2recomp与ssbu-recomp技术，并非传统模拟器，而是将Switch游戏代码转译为PC原生代码，使用Vulkan接口运行。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032009324502.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032009378726.jpg
目前0.4.5版本已经公开，支持Windows、Linux双平台。在测试场景如东京、涩谷关卡可实现60帧，最高支持4K内部渲染。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032009432714.jpg
项目自带PC专属设置面板，可调节分辨率缩放、垂直同步、各向异性过滤、纹理细节等图像选项；同时支持手柄，以及可重绑定键鼠、鼠标视角操控，键鼠功能还需要更多实机测试。
该项目仍处于早期开发阶段，完整主线流程尚未验证全部可玩，存在BUG、性能不稳与兼容性问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611032009498355.jpg

news.title: 外媒：PS6会有更多独占游戏！PS5破解倒逼索尼发力
news.summary: 近日，Areajugones发表了一篇深度分析，提出了一个颇具话题性的猜想：PS5破解社区的快速发展，或许会倒逼索尼为PS6打造更多真正的世…

content.v: 近日，Areajugones发表了一篇深度分析，提出了一个颇具话题性的猜想：PS5破解社区的快速发展，或许会倒逼索尼为PS6打造更多真正的世代独占游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031956208073.jpg
文章从索尼刚刚推送的PS5系统固件26.07-14.22.00说起，本次更新标注进行安全修复，官方并未披露具体封堵了哪些漏洞，外界普遍认为是索尼在为《GTA6》上线加固主机安全防线。
最近PS5破解社区进展迅猛，Relapse漏洞大幅扩大可修改主机范围，支持7.00至13.60版本固件。破解后的PS5不仅能运行自制程序，还可以刷入Linux、Windows系统、模拟器，大幅延长这台主机的使用生命周期。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031956312949.png
不过报道也强调，当前破解存在明显限制：Relapse 无法支持 13.60 之后固件，新大作大多要求更高版本系统，破解机并不能直接玩到《GTA6》这类新作；同时要区分自制开发、安全研究与盗版，目前没有可靠数据证明盗版已经给索尼造成大规模损失。
报道回顾了PS5世代初期的跨代策略。当年索尼为照顾超1.1 亿PS4 用户，《地平线：西之绝境》、《战神：诸神黄昏》等重磅作品同步登陆PS4与PS5，这直接冲淡了PS5的世代跃升感。如果 PS6继续沿用这种跨世代思路，已经破解的PS5将拥有极强竞争力。玩家手握一台可扩展功能、游戏库庞大的修改主机，会完全丧失更换新主机的动力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/03/small_202611031956372401.png
在Areajugones看来，索尼最好的应对手段，就是打造只能在PS6硬件上运行的世代独占游戏。这类作品依靠PS6专属硬件架构与性能开发，就算 PS5 被破解，也无法靠软件层面修改来强行运行。这不代表能彻底根除破解，却能给玩家一个充足理由放弃PS5、购入新主机。
报道也补充，这不代表索尼会立刻放弃跨平台游戏策略，庞大旧主机用户基数依旧存在商业价值，目前也没有证据表明破解已经直接干预索尼的开发路线。但PS5破解社区的壮大，确实给“回归世代独占”增加了新的说服力。

news.title: 王老菊做的游戏，到头来还是被喷烂了？
news.summary: 独立游戏，不是只靠热情就能完成的东西

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
王老菊的游戏终于做出来了！
历经了7年的漫长等待，太阳骑士，初代故事王，未来科技董事长，全B站最有梗的男人王老菊，终于带着他的游戏跟大伙见面了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/13880.jpg
2019年，董事长宣布要做游戏，我们翘首以盼；2023年，董事长直言600万尚无成果，我们担忧但相信；2026年，当我们正式玩到《再再启程》时，却不得不面对一个事实：这一路的颠沛流离，似乎没得到一个好结局。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/14764.jpg
是的，《再再启程》大概也许是翻车了。
你如今能看到的大部分与之有关的视频，不是锐评就是狂喷，这个开发了七年，烧掉至少600万，经历好几次推倒重来终于上线的游戏，到底什么情况？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/20832.jpg
讲道理，什么七年上百万之类的噱头，也就听起来唬人 ，实际上老粉都知道如今《再再启程》能够跟大伙见面，经历了数次推倒重来，董事长自述他们放弃了两个项目，然后用第三个项目留下的遗产搓出了这么一个轻量小游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/20983.jpg
这七年的时间和数百万资金，大部分都耗费在了绕远路上。真正落到如今这款游戏上的开发时间和资金，或许远没有那么多。
不过一码归一码，《再再启程》确实没有网上说的那么耗时费钱，但它被喷，也实属罪有应得。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/21512.jpg
作为一个肉鸽构筑增量游戏，它的游戏内容，存在很多让玩家抓耳挠腮的矛盾。
先简单介绍一下《再再启程》的玩法，你需要开着一辆起初简陋，但会随着局内构筑越来越绿皮的独轮小车闯关获得成长资源，然后加点成长变强，直到完全打通游戏为止。
这里就出现了第一个矛盾点，它的增量系统加点后的增强十分明显，但局内构筑却显得不够强力，这导致你想要通关几乎要把局外成长点满。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/22585.jpg
这种问题放在放置挂机类的增量游戏里没人会有怨言，但是《再再启程》还偏偏有一点新意，车上所有的武器都有一套自己对应的操作方式，左轮需要上弹，弓箭需要拉弓，这一切虽然可以招募员工代劳，但武器还是会突发故障，或被天气影响失灵，需要你手动排障。
这就给人一种局内费劲巴拉忙前忙后，不如局外点点成长管用的挫败感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/30566.jpg
此外，当你数值上去了之后，游戏依然存在一个让人爽不起来的设定，车上这么多工具，都是有消耗和负载的，你要同时考虑武器的输出效率和车子的续航才能顺利通关，火力太弱打不过怪，火力太强车跑不到终点......
作为一款构筑肉鸽，总是让人爽不起来可就太致命了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/39766.jpg
而抛开这些游戏性问题，作为一款“王老菊”的游戏，它的情怀分似乎还算差强人意。
开小车的玩法似乎来自“赵日天号”，那些从他视频里诞生的梗也大部分都做成了可招募的特殊角色，阿飞，响当当，紫色古神.......
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/44563.jpg
除了这些彩蛋性质的致敬，就没有什么“含菊量”明显的地方了，那些令人会心一笑的王老菊式幽默并没有在游戏中体现，换一个完全不了解王老菊的玩家来，也只会给出“普普通通”的评价。况且它原价卖68，对于这种小游戏卖相的作品来说还是太贵了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/52079.jpg
简而言之，作为粉丝向作品这个游戏缺乏足够的作者性，作为小品级独立游戏又缺乏扎实的玩法循环。
而且结合当下的游戏圈环境，它难免被人拿去跟AI美术AI文案AI代码的“3A”游戏比较。虽然我们在23年的时候早就看过了《再再启程》的开发中画面，实际上手游玩后手搓感也很明显。
但这拦不住路过的玩家们觉得：这看上去不算复杂的小游戏，似乎真的存在那么一丝丝能被AI全面接管的可能性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261103_hzf_653_1/57003.jpg
大伙都清楚《再再启程》其实算得上一个合格的小品级独立游戏，有玩法上的巧思，有至少8个小时的体量，也有说得过去的粉丝属性.......
但我们都期待着它不止如此，但同时又清楚地知道，它也只能是这样了。
作为一个有着良好风评的百万粉老牌Up主，费尽心思后做出了这样远称不上优秀的作品，一套“爆爆爆”的“知名Up主消费粉丝情怀”的节奏似乎是顺理成章的。
对如今的网友们来说，Up主翻车后迎来口诛笔伐众叛亲离，早已是司空见惯的事。
然而，那些“狂喷”《再再启程》的视频骂得再狠，似乎都没有掀起什么波澜，更诡异的是它在Steam上仍有85%的好评率，维持着特别好评。
评论区的风向突出一个遗憾但支持——“游戏确实不太行，但好评是给王老菊的”。
这话放到如今的互联网环境里很容易被解读成“洗”和“孝”，但只因为他是王老菊，尖锐严苛的差评和温和宽容的好评才能同时以这种形式存在。
是的，跟评论区的大伙一样，虽然说了那么多批评的话，我却仍旧无法去抨击董事长想做出自己游戏的初心。
【此处有 GIF，请在后台添加】
坚持产出系列长视频，只用真实的体验说话，没有架子挨骂就认，又能给粉丝们源源不断地带来欢乐 ，他几乎就是游戏实况时代的完美代言人。
玩家们支持的永远是王老菊这个人，而不是真的认同这款游戏。从七年前他决定自己做一款游戏开始，一路上的徘徊与努力几乎都被粉丝们看在眼里，我们看着他成立未来科技工作室，看着他分享开发故事，看着他招人......也眼睁睁看着他陷入困境烧掉百万资金仍然一无所获。
最后，他也明明白白地告诉了粉丝，最后终于要端上餐桌的是一个他自己也不满意的作品。没怎么宣传，也没亲自游玩，他甚至没在仅有的一个预告上线的动态里说出什么赞美之词。可谓低调到了唯唯诺诺的地步。
但，再怎么反思，再怎么低调，都无法改变《再再启程》只是一部平庸的作品的事实。而关于为什么最后端出来的是这样的东西这个问题，社区倒是有几个看上去煞有介事的猜测：什么作为甩手掌柜被吃回扣啦，什么项目管理能力欠缺无能为力啦......
核心思想就一个：给王老菊找补找补，留点面子。
无论我们再怎么喜欢王老菊本人，再怎么对《再再启程》恨铁不成钢，都无法改变一个事实。作为玩家，老菊有着堪称顶级品味，但作为开发者，他似乎暂时还不具备将品味转化为产品的能力。
历经漫长的开发过程，两次推倒重来，其中的挫折和体悟董事长决定留给自己，而这款终于端出来的《再再启程》与其说是项成果，不如说是个交代。
“未来科技工作室”不是个噱头，王老菊的游戏梦并非有始无终，他仍然是那个亲切的董事长，而且他自己也知道，自己经历了一场失败。
他用切实的经历和付出再次证明了那个行业真理：独立游戏，不是只靠热情就能完成的东西。
但至少事情还不算太糟，他没有奢求粉丝们的关注乃至拥护，也没有大肆宣传消耗来之不易的信任，只是自己咽下了失败事实......所以，我们才仍然愿意相信王老菊还能够再再启程。

news.title: “中国之星计划”第四期新增多家战略合作伙伴，单项目将获价值百万美元投资
news.summary: 2026年11月3日，索尼互动娱乐（上海）有限公司（以下简称“索尼互动娱乐”）今日在上海举办“中国之星计划”发布会，正式宣布该计划第四期项目支持力度再次升级：对每个入选项目进行价值100万美元的项目投资；同时，引入更多战

content.v: 2026年11月3日，索尼互动娱乐（上海）有限公司（以下简称“索尼互动娱乐”）今日在上海举办“中国之星计划”发布会，正式宣布该计划第四期项目支持力度再次升级：对每个入选项目进行价值100万美元的项目投资；同时，引入更多战略合作伙伴拓展全球网络，包括DENMU電夢及Solutions 2 GO（以下简称“S2G”），为开发者提供更具针对性的专业服务。
“中国之星计划”第三期重点游戏《绝晓》将获得价值100万美元的项目投资，《达巴：水痕之地》将于2027年春季发售；《潜阈限界》将于2027年内发售。
https://image.gcores.com/605925d3092d5954ba6143c89cc28704-1152-744.jpeg
2026中国之星计划发布会圆满成功
“中国之星计划”自2016年启动以来，至今已累计选拔19款国产游戏，其中11款已经成功上市，项目也在不断成长和优化中，致力于协助本土开发者快速成长，将更多具有中国文化特色的优质游戏带给全球玩家。
索尼互动娱乐（上海）有限公司董事长兼总裁江口达雄在现场分享了PlayStation在中国的任务和愿景：“PlayStation想建立一座连接中国和世界的游戏文化交流之桥：积极将海外高品质硬件产品和游戏内容带来中国，满足中国玩家多样化的游玩需求；同时，深化与本土游戏团队合作，让更多中国游戏通过PlayStation走向全球。”
https://image.gcores.com/b28863bcaaa96cf23df9fe88c2b9ff4b-1152-598.jpeg
江口达雄，索尼互动娱乐（上海）有限公司董事长兼总裁 发表讲话
会上，“中国之星计划”领导者、索尼互动娱乐中国软件事业部总经理 Sean Kelly表示：“ PlayStation持续优化’中国之星计划’项目，不断加大投资力度，致力于为中国游戏开发者提供更完善、更全面的支持体系。不断涌现的优质国产游戏作品也让我们更加确信中国游戏开发者的巨大潜力与热情。”
https://image.gcores.com/7115e468b60c856b3aa40c929d156558-1138-621.jpeg
Sean Kelly，索尼互动娱乐中国软件事业部总经理 发布致辞
第四期支持政策再度升级
“中国之星计划”第四期计划在延续初期公开的游戏开发、发行、市场推广等全方位支持的基础上，进行支持力度的再次升级：一方面，第四期将对每个入选项目进行价值100万美元的项目投资，确保入选项目获得充足的资源支持；另一方面，在原公开的第四期合作伙伴名单外，还将引入DENMU電夢及S2G作为新的合作伙伴成员，为入选游戏项目提供更完善的支持体系。
https://image.gcores.com/8a1b83b1c9620cbb2478855c0adae929-1155-610.jpeg
包波，索尼互动娱乐（上海）有限公司游戏制作总监 公布中国之星计划第四期进展
DENMU電夢是一家专注全球游戏行业的投资机构，致力于支持具有独特创意的游戏开发者。由暗星科技（《救赎之路》的开发商）开发的《达巴：水痕之地》是中国之星计划第三期的入选作品，也是DENMU電夢在中国投资的众多游戏之一。以《达巴：水痕之地》为合作起点，DENMU電夢将与“中国之星计划”一起，在项目资金、开发协助及市场推广等方面为中国游戏开发者提供有力支持。
https://image.gcores.com/d24fd823731545fb37212d42dfac6d1a-1203-677.jpeg
游镕畅，DENMU電夢管理合伙人&CEO现场分享
S2G作为一家提供全方位服务的分销公司，早在22年前就与PlayStation开展合作。作为中国之星计划的合作伙伴，S2G计划协助发行第三期入选游戏《达巴：水痕之地》及《潜阈限界》。
https://image.gcores.com/e5624f6183db62ef52cf2c3aac073ecd-1224-603.jpeg
片方祐介，Solutions 2 GO Asia Vice President, Asia Publishing 现场分享
中国之星计划入选游戏《无限机兵》于2025年3月正式发售，获得诸多业界好评。中电博亚CE-Asia作为这款游戏的发行方，也在现场分享了如何与开发者协同、提高项目确定性，并成功将游戏带给世界玩家的幕后故事。
https://image.gcores.com/86ffb2076a61599a74c78f7e6d7aeb8d-1142-564.jpeg
吴立，中电博亚CE-Asia总裁 现场分享
第三期重点项目《绝晓》获追加投资
